test_title: PYST 27: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true even if it seems to be at variance from commonly known facts, Decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the given statements.

Statement:

All fathers are brothers.

All brothers are sons.

Conclusion:

(I) All fathers are sons.

(II) All brothers are fathers.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
Given Statements:

All fathers are brothers.

All brothers are sons.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/766d60e88391a23348d22764997a7aa33758a60bc3422b9b37a0400990338d7a.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) All fathers are sons:

This is the direct, valid conclusion derived from combining the two statements.

Therefore, Conclusion (I) logically follows.

(II) All brothers are fathers​:

In logic, "All A are B" does not imply "All B are A." For example, "All dogs are animals" does not mean "All animals are dogs."

Therefore, Conclusion (II) does not follow as it is a conversion of a universal affirmative statement, which is not necessarily valid.

So, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
